_comment: Emeria's INTERVENING IF, positive half (pair: lhc_emeria_six_plains_no_trigger). Six Plains + Emeria + Heliod (devotion 1, not a creature) on the battlefield, a Plains in hand, ONLY Ranger-Captain of Eos in the graveyard, Walking Ballista the library's only creature; Emeria's search axis OFF so the trigger takes its list's front. T7 plays the 7th Plains, so T8's upkeep trigger exists and returns Ranger-Captain (the only target), which tutors Ballista; Ballista X=1 + Heliod's lifelink grant loops for the kill on T8. The paired six-Plains board is identical but one Plains short, and must NOT win.
